interpretation: Local rule-resource indicators, not an official Azure WAF assessment, certification, Polaris or WARA grade.
Checklist IDs and GUIDs are references. Legacy graph snippets are never executed.
Standard/Premium and AKS Automatic/NAP replace obsolete Paid-tier and universal fixed-pool assumptions.
Azure CNI Overlay/Cilium is supported; a legacy default maxPods=30 is not a universal density limit.
Absent IaC, requirements, DR tests, licensing or telemetry is not evidence of drift, failure or health.
Configuration presence is distinct from effective enforcement, source health, entitlement and application availability.

rules.title: Cluster managed identity
rules.recommendation: Review the move to a managed identity with the owner; do not rotate credentials from this report.
rules.business_impact: A secret-based identity adds management work and expiry risk; no incident was measured.

rules.title: Managed Microsoft Entra integration
rules.recommendation: Validate a managed Microsoft Entra integration and its requirements before any change.
rules.business_impact: Decentralized authentication can make access control and revocation harder.

rules.title: Cluster RBAC authorization
rules.recommendation: Validate Kubernetes RBAC or Azure RBAC with least-privilege access; do not assume effective privileges without reading the assignments.
rules.business_impact: Disabled RBAC weakens authorization barriers; an enabled option does not prove least privilege.

rules.title: AKS local accounts
rules.recommendation: Review disabling local accounts after you check emergency access and Microsoft Entra.
rules.business_impact: Local accounts can bypass centralized identity controls.

rules.title: API server network access
rules.recommendation: Validate authorized ranges or a private endpoint against the requirements; keep the access paths you need.
rules.business_impact: An unrestricted public endpoint widens the access surface, but it does not prove exploitation.

rules.title: OIDC and Microsoft Entra Workload ID
rules.recommendation: Assess Workload ID for applications that access Azure; enabled does not mean every pod uses it.
rules.business_impact: Applications that need Azure can avoid long-lived secrets with a federated identity.

rules.title: Network policy engine
rules.recommendation: Validate a supported engine, including Cilium, if segmentation is a requirement; review the effective policies separately.
rules.business_impact: Without a supported engine, a NetworkPolicy might not enforce the expected segmentation.

rules.title: Network model and IPAM
rules.recommendation: Use the current guidance to choose Azure CNI Overlay or a justified alternative; do not force maxPods=30 or a migration without requirements.
rules.business_impact: A network choice that does not match the requirements can limit scalability and IP address space.

rules.title: Azure Policy configuration
rules.recommendation: Review Azure Policy or equivalent controls and get compliance results; the add-on does not prove compliance.
rules.business_impact: Unmanaged configuration controls can allow drift; compliance is not inferred from an add-on.

rules.title: Defender for Containers configuration
rules.recommendation: Review the need, cost, licensing and health of Defender; do not enable plans or agents from this reader.
rules.business_impact: Detection depends on actual coverage, licensing and telemetry, not only on an enabled profile.

rules.title: AKS tier and availability target
rules.recommendation: For production that needs an SLA, assess Standard or Premium and the current SLA terms.
rules.business_impact: A tier without an SLA might not support the contractual target; application availability was not calculated.

rules.title: Node pool zone distribution
rules.recommendation: When the requirement and the region allow it, plan distribution across zones and validate storage and capacity.
rules.business_impact: A pool that must be multi-zone but is not distributed can share a single failure domain.

rules.title: Node pool provisioning state
rules.recommendation: Investigate the pool's state and events with the owner; the cluster's Running state does not confirm pool or pod health.
rules.business_impact: An observed provisioning failure can affect operations or capacity; it does not prove a service outage.

rules.title: Applications outside System pools
rules.recommendation: Review where application pods run and separate system and user resources without forcing unnecessary affinity.
rules.business_impact: Application pods observed on System pools can compete with essential services.

rules.title: System pool scheduling protection
rules.recommendation: Review CriticalAddonsOnly or another suitable isolation strategy, and pod compatibility.
rules.business_impact: Without scheduling isolation, new workloads can compete with system components.

rules.title: Node scaling strategy
rules.recommendation: If dynamic scaling is required, review Cluster Autoscaler or NAP/Automatic, limits and tests; do not promise savings.
rules.business_impact: Fixed capacity might not follow changes in demand; without historical usage, overcapacity is not quantified.

rules.title: Kubernetes upgrade policy
rules.recommendation: Validate an automatic channel or a documented manual process, compatibility and maintenance; do not upgrade from the report.
rules.business_impact: Without a validated process, staying supported and patched is harder; a missing channel does not prove that there is no process.

rules.title: Node image upgrades
rules.recommendation: Review NodeImage, SecurityPatch or another documented process; do not recommend kured if the managed channel already covers the case.
rules.business_impact: The node image needs maintenance; a configured channel does not prove that an upgrade will complete.

rules.title: Version and current regional catalog
rules.recommendation: Compare the version, patches and support with the current regional catalog and upgrade profile; absence does not automatically mean end of support.
rules.business_impact: A version explicitly outside the support policy can raise operational risk; no fixed historical table is used.

rules.title: Control plane log configuration
rules.recommendation: Review the categories and destination of diagnostic settings and get evidence of delivery; do not confuse configuration with ingestion.
rules.business_impact: Without available logs, investigating changes and incidents can be harder.

rules.title: Current measurements available
rules.recommendation: Review time coverage and monitoring sources; a metrics.k8s.io sample does not prove monthly usage or end-to-end monitoring.
rules.business_impact: Capacity cannot be optimized on solid ground without measurements and a representative window.

rules.title: Maintenance windows
rules.recommendation: If planned maintenance is required, review windows and dependencies with the owner.
rules.business_impact: Undefined windows can make changes harder to coordinate, but they are not proof of disruption.

rules.title: CPU/memory requests and memory limit
rules.recommendation: Set requests and a memory limit from measurements; CPU limits are reviewed only when that requirement is explicit.
rules.business_impact: Observed missing requests or memory limits can make scheduling and isolation harder; requests are not consumption.

rules.title: Probes for workloads that serve traffic
rules.recommendation: For serving containers, validate readiness/liveness probes and their behavior; do not force probes on jobs or sidecars where they do not apply.
rules.business_impact: Without suitable probes, Kubernetes has fewer signals to route traffic to the application or restart it.

rules.title: PDB for replicated services
rules.recommendation: Define and test a suitable PDB for replicated services; check the selector, replicas and capacity during upgrades.
rules.business_impact: Without a PDB that selects the service, a voluntary disruption can evict too many pods; a PDB does not guarantee availability during failures.

rules.title: HPA when the workload needs scaling
rules.recommendation: Validate the target, min/max and metrics availability before you consider an HPA; a configured HPA does not prove effectiveness.
rules.business_impact: A service that needs scaling but has no controller might not match capacity to demand.

rules.title: Replicas for the availability target
rules.recommendation: Validate replicas and failure domains against the service requirement; zero replicas by design does not mean an outage.
rules.business_impact: A service that must be redundant but runs a single replica can have a single point of failure.

rules.title: Explicit Linux container privileges
rules.recommendation: Review privileged, allowPrivilegeEscalation and non-root execution against the container's needs; do not infer the image UID.
rules.business_impact: Explicitly configured elevated privileges can widen the impact of a compromise.

rules.title: Reproducible image references
rules.recommendation: Avoid latest or missing tags; assess digests, a private registry and supply-chain controls separately.
rules.business_impact: A mutable reference makes the deployed artifact harder to reproduce; a digest does not prove that the image is free of vulnerabilities.

rules.title: Namespace quotas per policy
rules.recommendation: When a shared namespace needs limits, review ResourceQuota and suitable values; do not confuse a quota with usage or billing.
rules.business_impact: Without a required quota, containing consumption across teams can be harder.

rules.title: Pod Security Admission configured
rules.recommendation: Validate enforce and equivalent Azure Policy controls; audit/warn do not block, and a label does not measure compliance.
rules.business_impact: An admission requirement that is not enforced can allow specifications that exceed the policy.

rules.title: NetworkPolicy that selects the workload
rules.recommendation: If segmentation is required, review selectors, policyTypes and rules; a selected policy does not prove effective isolation.
rules.business_impact: Without a required policy that selects the pods, the planned segmentation can be missing.

rules.title: PVC binding state
rules.recommendation: Investigate Lost, or Pending with an active consumer; WaitForFirstConsumer without a consumer can be normal.
rules.business_impact: An unbound volume that active pods need can block scheduling or data access.

rules.title: Azure Load Balancer SKU
rules.recommendation: Review Standard and its ELB/ILB configuration; a configured frontend and probe do not prove backend health.
rules.business_impact: An outdated SKU can limit support or capabilities; exposure is not inferred from the name alone.

rules.title: Storage HTTPS/TLS transport
rules.recommendation: Validate HTTPS and a modern minimum TLS version with the clients; this local rule narrows the checklist item on protecting associated PaaS resources.
rules.business_impact: Allowing insecure transport can expose data in transit; the rule does not measure actual access.

rules.title: Key Vault authorization model
rules.recommendation: Review Azure RBAC, or the reason for access policies, without reading secret values or changing permissions.
rules.business_impact: The model and its assignments need review to keep least privilege.

rules.title: NSG rules for administrative access from the internet
rules.recommendation: Review Allow rules from Internet to SSH/RDP or all ports, and the NSG association; do not delete rules automatically.
rules.business_impact: A broad explicit rule can open an access path if the NSG is associated and the target is listening.

rules.title: DNS and IPAM: performance not measured
rules.recommendation: Review resolution, latency, range capacity and LocalDNS with authorized tests; a DNS inventory does not prove availability.
rules.business_impact: Name resolution and IP space can limit operations; this reader did not measure DNS queries.

rules.title: Actual costs and Kubernetes attribution
rules.recommendation: Keep ActualCost by ResourceId/currency separate from namespace/workload allocation; do not enable cost analysis or install Kubecost.
rules.business_impact: Without allocation evidence, the node bill cannot be attributed to applications.

rules.title: Right-sizing with a representative window
rules.recommendation: Get historical usage, peaks and requirements before you change SKUs or requests; the current sample only guides a capacity review.
rules.business_impact: A point-in-time sample does not prove 30 days of underutilization or achievable savings.

rules.title: Spot eligibility and savings commitments
rules.recommendation: Validate eviction tolerance, history, demand and commercial eligibility; do not buy reservations or savings plans.
rules.business_impact: Potential discounts come with conditions and commitments that cannot be inferred from the inventory.

rules.title: Azure Advisor recommendation coverage
rules.recommendation: Review cached recommendations and their date/scope; an empty list does not prove that there are no opportunities anywhere.
rules.business_impact: Deciding to optimize needs applicable recommendations and evidence, not invented savings percentages.
